start.greeting:
Hi, this is {{appName}}.

Send me a document, photo, video, or audio file
and I will instantly create a share code for you.
start.menu:
Main commands:
📤 Send a file = create a share code
🔎 Send a code = retrieve a file
📁 /files = your files
📚 /help = full guide
start.deeplink_received: 📥 Detected share code {{shareCode}}. Fetching the file for you...
help.page.overview: 📖 How to use VaultLink 🔼 Upload — send any file in chat, you'll get a share code instantly 🔽 Retrieve — paste botname:CODE to fetch a file back ✨ Tricks • Multiple files / album in one go → auto-bundled into a Collection • Send a text during upload → captured as the description • Paste many codes in one message → delivered in order Tap a tab below to browse the commands.
help.page.files: 📁 Your files /files — list files + collections /del [CODE] — delete /set_password [CODE] [password] — set a password /remove_password [CODE] — remove the password /report [CODE] [reason] — report inappropriate content 🔐 visibility: public (everyone) / private (only you + admin)
help.page.bots: 🤖 Your bots /add_bot [BOT_TOKEN] — add a bot (default: public) /bots — list your bots /remove_bot @username — remove a bot Bot mode /mode public — 🌐 anyone can use it /mode private — 🔒 only you + allowed users User control (private mode) /allow [user_id] · /deny [user_id] /allow_upload [user_id] · /deny_upload [user_id] /stats — bot statistics
help.page.settings: 🔧 Settings & misc /settings — change language (th / en) /cancel — abort the current upload session 📄 /terms — Terms of Service 🔐 /privacy — Privacy Policy
help.page.admin: 🛡 Admin menu Any moderator (super admin OR bot owner) /admin_reports — pending reports /lock_file [CODE] — lock a file /unlock_file [CODE] — unlock /delete_file [CODE] — delete a file Super admin only /admin_stats · /admin_bots /ban [user_id] · /unban [user_id] /broadcast [message] Founder only (listed in ADMIN_IDS) /promote [user_id] · /demote [user_id] /super_admins — list
terms.body: 📄 VaultLink Bot Terms of Service 1. The service is provided as-is, without any availability guarantee. 2. Do not use the service to share content that is illegal in your jurisdiction, infringes on copyright, or harms others. 3. Administrators reserve the right to delete files, suspend accounts, or lock share codes that are reported or found to violate these terms. 4. You retain ownership of the files you upload and may delete them at any time. 5. Continued use of the service means you accept these terms.
privacy.body: 🔐 Privacy Policy • We store only what is necessary: Telegram IDs, language preference, uploaded file metadata, and usage statistics. • Personal bot tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. • File passwords are hashed with argon2id and cannot be recovered. • We do not inspect your file contents and do not share data with third parties. • You can delete your own files at any time via /files or /del.
